summary.headline: Astrological Tables and Treatises
summary.text: Catalog of manuscript Plut. 28, cod. 33, listing tables of notable cities, zodiacal fixed stars and decans, astrological material on Saturn, astrolabe treatises by John the Grammarian of Alexandria and Isaac Argyros, and works by Claudius Ptolemy and Hermes Trismegistus. It includes Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, the Book of the Fruit in 100 chapters, discussions of the twelve places, ascensions, declinations, planetary protection of life, and bodily mixtures.
